items.title: How AI Is Used by Netflix at Its VFX Eyeline Studios, Revealed by VP Mohsen Mousavi at View Conference
items.excerpt: Eyeline VP Mohsen Mousavi reveals how Netflix uses AI for crowds, sets and relighting, while developing new tools for filmmaking.

items.title: ‘Avatar: Fire and Ash’ Composer and More Speak Out About AI at Ghent’s WSA Film Music Days: ‘We Must Continue to Defend Our Art’
items.excerpt: At the World Soundtrack Awards, 'Avatar: Fire and Ash' composer Simon Franglen said the work of composers and musicians can never be replicated by AI.

items.title: Mia Goth Slams Instagram’s ‘Incomprehensible’ Decision to Let AI-Altered Selfie Spread Online
items.excerpt: Mia Goth has slammed Meta for allowing an AI-altered selfie posted by a fan account to circulate.

items.title: Midjourney: Report Finds AI Model Worst For Flouting Hollywood IP
items.excerpt: Disney accused Midjourney of being a "bottomless pit of plagiarism" in a lawsuit last year. More than 18 months on, there remains cause for concern.

items.title: Ava DuVernay Defends Using AI in New Doc ’14th’
items.excerpt: The director wants audiences to “make their decisions about how they feel” about the technology, which is used to bring to life some archival photos in the film.

items.title: China’s First AI Feature Flops At The Chinese Box Office
items.excerpt: Bona Film Group’s AI experiment struggled to attract attention, months after the humble 'Niu Lai’ turned online ridicule into almost $10 million in sales.

items.title: Animation And VFX Leaders Discuss AI And Jobs At View Conference
items.excerpt: Top studio executives discuss shifting production pipelines, tax incentives, new business opportunities, and if and how they can protect their workforces.

items.title: Hollywood Animation Directors On Distribution, Sequels, And AI
items.excerpt: At View, directors of 'GOAT,' 'Forgotten Island,' and Toy Story 5' discussed the state of the box office, original storytelling, and, unavoidably, AI.

items.title: Reallusion and Escape.AI Partner to Solve AI Video Bottlenecks and Expand Distribution

items.title: Sync.Labs Intros Zero-Shot Lipsyncing for Film and Television
items.excerpt: Sync.Labs is now offering Sync.Productions, which brings its studio-grade lipsync technology to film and television production. Built by a research-driven team of scientists

items.title: Astra Studios Launches AstraLabs, Teams with VerSe on AI Pipeline
items.excerpt: The Hombale Group-backed studio led by Biren Ghose and the Dailyhunt parent led by Umang Bedi will co-develop and market an AI-native pipeline built on SparkStation, which carries a production from script to distribution and keeps faces, wardrobe, and locations consistent across shots.

items.title: Blue Planet III is keeping the rough edges in the age of AI
items.excerpt: BBC’s Blue Planet III is keeping in shots that would normally end up on the cutting room floor to prove it’s real.
